通过回调函数监听`token`，获取来自上层中的[参数配置组件](/AntdCo.en-us: Monitor `token` to obtain style `token` values from the enclosing [configuration provider](/AntdConfigProvider), and use them to style other components. Clientside callbacks are recommended.
